steps: 1. Check that the device holds this flash: CRC-16 of sector 0 0x0+0x1000 = 0x3bd2, of the stock area 0x1000+0x23000 = 0xbcb7, of our sectors 0x41000+0x2d000 = 0xecf8 (erased).

2. Our area: erase 3 sectors 0x41000..0x43fff (already erased here; the first, with the directory, last), write 0x27a8 bytes (area-phys.bin; 40 writes of 256 bytes with 0x22, smcmidi sinco-write). Then CRC-16 of 0x41000+0x27a8 = 0xd898; the stock read (0x23) returns these bytes as stored, being above the stock VM start.
3. The boot pointer: sector 0's entry 3 (app_dir_head, at 0x60) from 0x1000 to 0x41000, the other 4064 bytes as they are: erase sector 0, write sector0-after.bin. Then CRC-16 of 0x0+0x1000 = 0xcec6.
4. Reset: the uboot reads the boot pointer 0x41000 and jumps to 0x1e00120 = flash 0x41120, the first byte of our app.bin.
rollback_steps: R1. Sector 0 back: erase it and write sector0-before.bin; CRC-16 of 0x0+0x1000 = 0x3bd2. The stock firmware starts again: its area was never touched.

R2. Erase our sectors 0x25000..0x36fff and 0x41000..0x6dfff (the configuration's slots and the panel's state, the area and the VM our firmware wrote), so the stock VM range holds nothing of ours; CRC-16 = 0x445f and 0xecf8.

R3. CRC-16 of the whole flash 0x0+0x80000 = 0xbb9f, the flash before, unless the stock firmware's own VM or BTIF were written in between (then compare range by range). The last line of defence stays the raw read of Rehearsal 1 (recovery.md).

rollback_steps: R1. Sector 0 back: erase it and write sector0-before.bin; CRC-16 of 0x0+0x1000 = 0x3bd2. The stock firmware starts again: its area was never touched.

R2. Erase our sectors 0x25000..0x36fff and 0x41000..0x6dfff (the configuration's slots and the panel's state, the area and the VM our firmware wrote), so the stock VM range holds nothing of ours; CRC-16 = 0x445f and 0xecf8.

R3. CRC-16 of the whole flash 0x0+0x80000 = 0xbb9f, the flash before with our sectors erased, unless the stock firmware's own VM or BTIF were written in between (then compare range by range). The last line of defence stays the raw read of Rehearsal 1 (recovery.md).
